scoring_justification: Cannot recompute elastic constants from raw fitting process without full dataset and optimization history; compare reported constants to paper-reported gold values with tolerance, and verify the derived constraint c13=c11+c12-c33.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for elastic constants and bulk modulus from the paper (Kiefte & Clouter, J. Chem. Phys. 64, 1816, 1976).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported central values for β‑N₂ at 63.0 K: c11=1.825, c12=1.131, c44=0.320, c33=1.976, c13=0.980 (all in 10^10 dyn/cm²), Bs=1.312.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's text and Table of results; the values match the reference solve.sh oracle.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published numbers; the reference solution writes them, so a correct reproduction will match.

outputs.description: Fitted elastic constants and adiabatic bulk modulus of β-nitrogen at 63.0 K.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each reported constant to paper-reported values within a relative tolerance of ±2%. The agent must not hardcode the target numbers; any attempt to look up the paper's values externally is against the spirit of the task.

steps.description: Compare reported elastic constants and bulk modulus to paper gold values (within ±2% relative tolerance) and verify c13=c11+c12-c33 within 0.01.
